parentContracts: S2-SG-LS-001 where System 2 evidence is reused only under its original provenance
purpose: Test whether quality-adjusted valuation adds incremental Taiwan-stock information beyond existing fundamentals, price/volume, sector/RS and regime without threshold mining.
preregisteredHypotheses: H1 expensive plus improving quality may be justified leadership rather than an automatic veto
H2 cheap plus deteriorating quality may represent a value-trap state
H3 cheap plus stable or improving quality may represent a value-quality state
H4 valuation may add more information for MAE/false-breakout/downside risk than for D1/D3 directional return
H5 cash-supported growth may outperform or carry lower downside risk than accounting-growth-with-cash-divergence after controls
killRules: Mark REDUNDANT if quality/valuation states add no stable increment after required controls.
Do not promote if effect is concentrated in one industry, one date cluster, one regime or one denominator convention.
Do not promote if source completeness/missingness predicts the outcome more strongly than the economic feature.
Do not promote if coverage or zero-pick degradation dominates any apparent benefit.
